meta.name: tweet
meta.description: Draft high-signal social posts from real work — auto-researches the current PR, recent commits, or working tree to capture the essence, then writes concise, human, builder-first posts for X/Twitter (and optionally Reddit).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把真实工作内容自动写成社交帖子
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从代码工作中提炼内容发社交媒体
copy.tagline_en: Auto-draft social posts from your real work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to distill your coding work into social media posts

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先自动查看当前代码变更、最近提交和 PR 信息，然后询问你有没有截图或视频，最后根据真实工作内容写出简洁、有技术感的社交帖子（支持 X/Twitter 和 Reddit）。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 为你的编程工作写一条社交帖子时触发，比如“帮我发个推”或“写个 Reddit 帖子”。

say.text: 帮我为这个 PR 写一条推文。
用更技术化的语气写个 Reddit 帖子。
say.note: Claude 会调整风格，包含实现细节和局限性。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically researches current code changes, recent commits, and PR info, then asks if you have visuals, and finally writes concise, technically grounded social posts (supports X/Twitter and Reddit).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to write a social post about your engineering work, e.g., 'write a tweet for this PR' or 'draft a Reddit post'.

say_en.text: Write a tweet for this PR.
say_en.note: Claude will research the PR, ask about visuals, then provide options.

say_en.text: Write a Reddit post in a more technical tone.
say_en.note: Claude will adjust style to include implementation details and limitations.
